summary: The strip is clean of pops, flicker and camera moves, but the figure is a tiny, static silhouette and no rope or spin shows in the first frames of the lasso shot.

faults.what: The shot is meant to be the first lasso spun over his head. Across 108.39 to 108.63 the figure is a tiny, dark, unchanging silhouette on the ring. There is no rope, no loop, no raised arm and no wind-up, so the lasso idea doesn't read at the start of the shot.
faults.fix: Show a visible rope loop and a clear spin pose from frame 1, and scale the figure up or push the camera in so the action reads.
